in_marathi.name: Kirtan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे To hear, to recite
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kirtan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The word 'Kirtan' is derived from the Sanskrit root 'kirt', meaning 'to hear' or 'to recite'. In Hinduism, Kirtan refers to the devotional practice of chanting the names of God or the repeating of sacred mantras. It is a powerful spiritual practice believed to bring inner peace, purification, and connection with the divine.
